## 1. Biography & Professional Role
- **Full Name**: Barış Salih Babacan
- **Title**: CTO & Lead Developer @ Garage.ist · Systems Engineer
- **Garage.ist**: an Istanbul product studio building consumer iOS and Android apps. He has led its development since October 2024, working in a two-developer team.
- **Earlier**: IT & Systems Integration Intern at ENLOG, Istanbul (Sep 2023 – Jun 2024), alongside high school.
- **Education**: Associate degree in Computer Programming, Istanbul University Open & Distance Education Faculty (2024–present). Haydarpaşa Vocational & Technical High School, Network Management & Cyber Security (2020–2024).
- **Location**: Istanbul, Turkey (open to remote, EU/US overlap)
- **Focus**: local-first systems in Rust, network protocol reverse engineering, native iOS/iPadOS apps, embedded/serial hardware integration.

## 3. Projects

### 3.1 Osmos (open source)
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Developer (2026–) · **Status**: alpha
- **What it is**: a local-first version control engine.
- **Architecture**: a three-crate Rust workspace. osmos-core detects file changes, stores BLAKE3-addressed blobs and keeps repository, commit and branch metadata in SQLite. osmos-daemon exposes ten typed commands (init, status, branch, switch, merge, commit, …) over a Unix domain socket with newline-delimited JSON and UUID-correlated requests. osmos-transport is reserved for the planned mDNS discovery + QUIC peer sync and is not implemented yet. Zero `unsafe` blocks. An early Tauri 2 + React 19 + TypeScript desktop client sits on top.
- **Tech**: Rust · Tauri · React · TypeScript · SQLite · BLAKE3
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Osmos-App/osmos-core

### 3.2 Mythos (open source)
- **Role**: Creator & Developer (2026) · **Status**: in development
- **What it is**: a local-first IDE for novelists writing multi-book, relational fiction worlds.
- **Architecture**: mythoside-core is a six-crate Rust workspace (parser, narrative model, workspace, RPC, shared types) with no UI dependencies. Manuscripts live on disk as Markdown + YAML in a Series → Book → Chapter → Scene hierarchy. The engine exposes 13 JSON-RPC methods over stdio and never opens a network port; the Tauri 2 + React client (mythoside-ts) runs it as a managed sidecar, with TypeScript types generated from Rust. 82 tests. A SQLite + FTS5 index for cross-referencing is planned, not built.
- **Tech**: Rust · Tauri · React · TypeScript
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Mythos-IDE/mythoside-core

### 3.3 Chorus (open source)
- **Role**: Founding Engineer (2026–) · **Status**: early development, v0.1.0-alpha
- **What it is**: an anonymous discussion engine without accounts, likes or algorithmic feeds.
- **Architecture**: every thread and message is written as an immutable Git commit, so there is no database in the dependency tree. Thread-scoped temporary identities replace user accounts. The Go 1.22+ backend has per-endpoint IP token-bucket rate limiting, `X-Request-ID` correlation across logs and error payloads, and a 10-second graceful shutdown that never interrupts an in-flight Git write. 24 tests and 5 benchmarks measure the cost of Git as storage. React 19 + TypeScript + Vite frontend.
- **Tech**: Go · React · TypeScript · Vite · Git
- **Repository**: https://github.com/joinchorus/chorus · **Site**: https://joinchorus.app

### 3.4 IT-RMS (personal production project)
- **Role**: Lead Architect & Developer (2023–) · **Status**: migration in progress
- **What it is**: the IT asset system for his vocational high school's IT department.
- **Architecture**: started in 2023 in PHP 8 + MySQL (Composer, PHPMailer, barcode generation): multi-branch inventory, 2D lab layouts, barcode/QR labels, PDF reporting, audit logging, stock alerts and a five-role user model. In 2026 he returned to it and is migrating it to Node.js, Express 5 and MongoDB (Mongoose) in an MVC layout with linting, input validation and security headers; the PHP version is preserved on a branch.
- **Tech**: PHP 8 · MySQL · Node.js · Express · MongoDB · Passport · QRCode
- **Repository**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan/IT-Department-Resource-Management-System

### 3.5 Q-PASS (personal production project)
- **Role**: System Architect · **Status**: completed, no longer in use
- **What it is**: RFID access control and meal tracking for a public school (Haydarpaşa MTAL).
- **Architecture**: custom 3D-printed RFID readers run C++ microcontroller firmware and send structured serial frames over RS-232/USB to a Python service, which validates them against a PHP/MySQL dashboard for access logs and meal quotas. It served 120–150 people a day for three school years.
- **Tech**: Arduino (C++) · Python · PHP · MySQL · RFID
- **Repository**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan/Q-PASS-RFID-Access-Control

### 3.6 Garage.ist projects
- **Sortify** (CTO & Lead Developer): game-based learning app for children aged 3–13 with supervision tools for parents and teachers. Native SwiftUI + MVVM on iOS/iPadOS, split into six in-house Swift packages (core, auth, education, games, subscription, chessboard); Firebase Auth/Firestore/Functions, server-side StoreKit 2 purchase verification, push notifications, analytics and mDNS device pairing. v2.1 on the App Store, 540+ commits. CI blocks direct pushes to main and self-merged pull requests.
- **Sortify Web** (Lead Developer): the browser client, porting the iOS game logic to React 19 + TypeScript + Vite with HTML5 Canvas rendering.
- **+TV** (Co-developer · Philips integration): Android TV remote, cast and screen-mirroring app with 10K+ downloads on Google Play, built with a fellow developer. Samsung via the Tizen SDK and LG via ConnectSDK. Philips had no SDK, so he reverse-engineered the undocumented JointSpace API from Philips' own remote app (logs via CatLog, traffic via Wireshark) and wrote that integration alone: HTTP Digest auth over a 401 challenge–response with a nonce, PIN pairing as an explicit state machine, nonce expiry handling and self-signed TLS. Working in 2–5 days, fully mapped in about three weeks.
- **World Clock** (Lead Developer): interactive time zone map with D3 orthographic projections morphing into 2D maps, live solar terminator and a multi-city meeting planner, prerendered for SEO. React 18 · D3.js · TopoJSON · Vite. https://worldclock.info
- **Gayrimenkul Dünyası** (Backend Integration & Firebase Infrastructure): real estate data collection and CRM platform on Next.js App Router, with Playwright-based collection jobs and Google News RSS parsing into Cloud Firestore.
- **Spor Sayfası** (Infrastructure & Backend Integration): sports news portal on Next.js. His part: Firebase infrastructure and hosting, record persistence, and fixing the news-ingestion API integration.
- **RuleSort and Block Nest**: two additional iOS games shipped to the App Store.

### Babaların Günahları (The Sins of the Fathers)
- **Type**: Novel · **Genre**: psychological fiction / drama
- **Status**: under review, submitted to the Everest First Novel Award
- **Synopsis**: a three-generation family saga from the streets of Scotland to the towers of Los Angeles, about inherited guilt, moral responsibility and a man's reckoning with his own conscience.
- **Website**: https://thesinsofthefathers.com
